name: Keto Turkey Meatloaf

Ruling DUPE per 'only one survives'; flagging so the audit stage can override if a low-carb variant is explicitly wanted.
cross_protein_collision: Structurally this is 'ketchup-glazed baked meatloaf'. A beef meatloaf or pork meatloaf in another selector's pool would be the same-dish-different-protein twin - not a dupe of this turkey entry, but the decider's cross-protein merge should watch for a cluster of near-identical meatloaves across proteins.
